text.text: The Cisco 4321 Integrated Services Router (ISR) is the next affordable platform of the Cisco 4000 ISR Series. It is a revolutionary converged branch platform with industry-leading network, compute, and WAN services. The Cisco 4321 ISR provides up to 100 Mbps performance in a 1-rack unit (1RU) desktop form factor with two NIM slots and zero SM slot.

graphic.text: The Cisco 4321 Integrated Services Router (ISR) is the next affordable platform of the Cisco 4000 ISR Series. It is a revolutionary converged branch platform with industry-leading network, compute, and WAN services. The Cisco 4321 ISR provides up to 100 Mbps performance in a 1-rack unit (1RU) desktop form factor with two NIM slots and zero SM slot.

text.text: Concurrent software services at speeds up to 2 Gbps. Backplane architecture supports high-bandwidth module-to-module communication at speeds up to 10 Gbps. A distributed multicore architecture with the industry’s first internal services plane. Remote installation of application-aware services, which run identically to their counterparts in dedicated appliances. Router capacity can be increased with a remote performance-on-demand license upgrade (no hardware upgrade) for exceptional savings.
